title: Nonnegative random subset weight
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $0\le\delta\le1$, and let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Then $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}\ge0$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
